definitions.explanation: A sudden onset of symptoms or a medical episode, such as a seizure, asthma attack, or panic attack.
A sudden, uncontrollable urge or burst of emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧。
⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おかげ→おかげ：01362_okage⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回数|かいすう}→回数：00139_kaisuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}って→減る：01985_heru⟧きた。
examples.english: Thanks to the medication, the frequency of attacks has decreased.

examples.japanese: ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I was seized by a fit of laughter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{我|われ}→我：30648_ware⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I lost myself in a fit of rage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{泣|な}き{出|だ}した→泣き出す：06343_nakidasu⟧。
examples.english: She burst into tears as if seized by a sudden fit.

notes:
{発作|ほっさ} refers to a sudden onset of symptoms, whether medical or emotional.

PRONUNCIATION:
Note the double consonant — ほっさ, not はっさ.

MEDICAL TYPES:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧{発作|ほっさ}: heart attack
- ⟦{喘息|ぜんそく}→喘息：08444_zensoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ}: asthma attack
- ⟦パニック→パニック：11171_panikku⟧{発作|ほっさ}: panic attack
- てんかん{発作|ほっさ}: epileptic seizure

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {発作|ほっさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧: to have an attack/fit
- {発作|ほっさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: for an attack to occur
- {発作|ほっさ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧: to be seized by a fit
- {発作|ほっさ}{的|てき}(な): paroxysmal, impulsive, sudden

USAGE:
Also used for sudden emotional outbursts: ⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ} (fit of laughter), ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発作|ほっさ} (fit of rage).
